match: a Gaussian bell bump / normal-distribution surface — labels like "gaussian", "bell curve", "bump", "3d hill", or a smooth mound sketch
params: {"sigma": 0.25-1.6; "flat": true|false — start flattened/unfolded; "slice": true|false — open the slicing plane; "tilt": 0-180, "offset": -1.4..1.4, "spin": 0-360, "cut": "full"|"above"|"below"} — all optional
